source: Iced-Cream's own tests on their unit, two runs of build KBH7 on 2026-11-08: elkbench plans KBH F1, T1 and F2 (r-bf3d20, r-05d8db, r-0ef22c), then F1, T2 and F2 (r-4c42e5, r-3a1a42, r-5cff4c), each gated in the emulator on the same PC; then, 2026-11-09, build KBH8 on the current base: F1, T3 and F2 (r-bf0528, r-03dac9, r-7cf43c), gated the same way
statement: On an Analog Rytm MKII with OS 1.74 and this package on Modwerk's base (core-ar2 0.7, plain variant ba530f45, with analoghealth 1.2 for remote keys), build KBH7, 2026-11-08, through the KIT menu's RELOAD: KIT menu RELOAD twice on an unedited kit: KIT RELOADED! both times, saved BD DEC kept (screen). BD DEC turned to 0; RELOAD: KIT RELOADED! with the saved DEC; RELOAD again: EDITS RESTORED! with DEC at 0 (screens). After RELOAD armed the A/B, DEC turned to 127; RELOAD: KIT RELOADED! (not EDITS RESTORED!) with the saved DEC; RELOAD again: EDITS RESTORED! with DEC at 127, not the stashed 0 (screens). After DEC to 0 and RELOAD armed the A/B, KIT menu LOAD KIT loaded kit 2; two RELOADs then both showed KIT RELOADED! on kit 2, never EDITS RESTORED! (screens; second run, 2026-11-08 23:01). CPU 74-77 %, heap flat. On 2026-11-09, build KBH8 (the current plain base 1c14b6b0, analoghealth 1.2): NO + PLAY MODE (key 0xb5) on an unedited kit, twice: KIT 1 RELOADED! both times, saved BD DEC kept (screens). BD DEC turned to 0; NO + PLAY MODE: KIT 1 RELOADED! with the saved DEC; NO + PLAY MODE again: EDITS RESTORED! with DEC at 0 (screens). The stop square was checked after every press: the sequencer stayed stopped, so transport PLAY was not pressed. CPU 74-75 %, heap flat.
scope: kit-ab 1.0.0 on Modwerk's base: KBH7 (plain ba530f45) through the KIT menu's RELOAD; KBH8 (plain 1c14b6b0) through NO + PLAY MODE. Not covered: persistence across a power cycle (by design the stash is not kept).

builds.label: KBH7
builds.content: Stock OS 1.74 + Modwerk base for core-ar2 0.7 (plain variant ba530f45) + analoghealth 1.2 (remote keys, test harness; no site shared with this module) + kit-ab 1.0.0, linked by scripts/link-image.mjs. Driven by elkbench plans after their emulator gate; stock 1.74 restored at the end.
results: KIT menu RELOAD twice on an unedited kit: KIT RELOADED! both times, saved BD DEC kept (screen).
BD DEC turned to 0; RELOAD: KIT RELOADED! with the saved DEC; RELOAD again: EDITS RESTORED! with DEC at 0 (screens).
After RELOAD armed the A/B, DEC turned to 127; RELOAD: KIT RELOADED! (not EDITS RESTORED!) with the saved DEC; RELOAD again: EDITS RESTORED! with DEC at 127, not the stashed 0 (screens).
CPU 76.6 / 76.2 %, DSP 70.1 / 70.0 %, heap flat, two readings 30 s apart after the flash.
After DEC to 0 and RELOAD armed the A/B, KIT menu LOAD KIT loaded kit 2; two RELOADs then both showed KIT RELOADED! on kit 2, never EDITS RESTORED! (screens; second run, 2026-11-08 23:01).
Second run: CPU 74.7 / 74.2 %, DSP 70.0 / 69.8 %, heap flat after the flash.
notRun: KBH7's runs (2026-11-08) used the KIT menu's RELOAD; their remote NO(PLAY) pressed transport PLAY, not the reload gesture.
A power cycle (the stash is not kept, by design) was not run.

A change of kit ends the A/B (second run)

contextNote: Main OS hash is the build's, not read back from the device. The first run's T1 is recorded as failed in its last section, on a kit-list reference that compared screen content the plan does not control; the second run's T2 covered that section with the check narrowed to the cursor row, and passed. The third run (KBH8) pressed NO + PLAY MODE, stock's kit reload key, by remote keys, and passed.
